kpis.label: European allies pledged at The Hague to reach 3.5% of GDP core defence spending by 2035; Germany is targeting 2029 on a €108B 2026 defence budget (+25% YoY), so the European demand runway is intact even as listed European names de-rate on execution

kpis.sub: 2026 YTD · DEFENSE TECH VC, PAST 2025'S $9.6B FULL-YEAR RECORD
kpis.label: Early-stage rounds are pricing at 17x-50x revenue; Anduril's raise at ~$100B (first reported Jul 24, vs. a $61B mark set about two months earlier) is still unclosed roughly eleven weeks on, with no new defense-tech mega-round confirmed this week

The stopgap blocks new program starts: Golden Dome has under $400M of base-budget authority with ~$17.1B of its $17.5B request dependent on a reconciliation bill, and the $54.6B FY27 DAWG drone line cannot begin; the Pentagon has warned of a $500B-$700B gap between plans and likely appropriations

kpis.sub: ANDURIL'S AIR FORCE CCA PRODUCTION AWARD · SEP 26
kpis.label: The Air Force named Anduril's FQ-44A Fury and General Atomics' FQ-42A Vengeance for CCA production — 150 airframes initially, scaling toward 500 by 2032 at roughly $20M/unit, split between the two — a production milestone that supports an eventual Anduril IPO regardless of when its private round closes

tiers.label: Established / Software & Primes
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Shares jumped ~4-5% to ~$206-209 on Oct 9 (a record close) after Barclays initiated at Overweight with a $265 target and Goldman upgraded to Buy with a $230 target on Oct 8; Q2 revenue grew 92.8% to $1.935B (U.S. commercial +149%), but the stock now sits above the ~$196 prior consensus target
rows.watch for: Valuation after the rally (~85x forward earnings last confirmed, ~160x trailing), ~$265M of quarterly stock-based compensation and government-contract termination risk; Q3 results will need to clear a much higher bar, and CEO Alex Karp's AI-lab nationalization comment remains a regulatory thread

rows.angle: Shares closed at €935.30 on Oct 9 — down ~40% year-to-date and 3.6% above the 52-week low — despite an €80.5B backlog; Berenberg cut its target from €1,600 to €1,020 and downgraded Buy to Hold, while insider buying (CEO Papperger ~€499K on Sep 29; a board-linked foundation ~€239K on Oct 2) offers a counterweight
rows.watch for: Q3 results on Nov 5 will test backlog quality and cash conversion; delivery delays on wheeled vehicles and Skyranger, negative operating free cash flow and July's loss of the €12.8B F126 frigate program remain unresolved; a $20.7M U.S. Army weapon-mounts order and a new Norwegian branch are small positives

rows.angle: Shares closed at $236.92 on Oct 8, hugging the $233.01 52-week low (high $379.23) with analyst consensus at Hold; the ~$6B Lockheed THAAD propulsion contract (Sep 29, undefinitized) and a $1B Pentagon convertible investment in the Missile Solutions unit (IPO now mid-2027) are the support
rows.watch for: Q3 earnings date was set Oct 5; the CR freezes new starts including $921.9M of THAAD production, Golden Dome is largely suspended, and the Kubasik exit (CEO Sam Mehta since August) is still not fully explained

rows.angle: Shares were about 1,832p on Oct 7 — materially lower than last week's note of a 'mid-2,000s' recovery, which was an unverified carry-forward and is corrected here — after a >5% weekly drop on fears the UK may delay its 3%-of-GDP defence target (possibly to Q3 2027) and higher gilt yields; the record £84.0B H1 backlog and raised guidance (8-10% sales growth, 11-13% EPS growth) are unchanged
rows.watch for: UK fiscal credibility and the pace of the UK defence-spending ramp; roughly half of revenue is U.S.-linked, so the CR and FY27 appropriations matter, and H2 execution against raised guidance is still unproven

tiers.label: High-Growth Autonomy Pure-Plays
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Shares at ~$137 (Oct 8) trade ~42%+ below the start of the year and below both the 50- and 200-day averages, having slipped ~5% on Oct 7 in a drone-sector selloff despite the Sep 9 beat ($0.59 EPS vs. $0.22; $480.5M revenue) and the $464.8M Army LOCUST laser award plus a first international LOCUST order; consensus target ~$232
rows.watch for: Analyst target cuts (Stifel, Piper Sandler), the earlier BADGER/SCAR cancellation and goodwill impairment, and the CR delaying new autonomy program starts the growth story depends on

rows.angle: Shares fell to ~$42 (Oct 8) from ~$51 a week earlier — a ~17% drop that outpaced peers, and a rare relative bright spot only on the day (+0.4%); the CCA production decision keeps GE GEK800 engine optionality alive and the Orbit acquisition, JDAM-ER propulsion and a ~$35M award add breadth
rows.watch for: Backlog-to-revenue conversion at a premium multiple (~5x sales at the lower price versus ~4.6x industry), Kratos again missing the Gauntlet II leaderboard, and the CR delaying new starts; drone-sector flows (JEDI ETF -4% on Oct 7) are driving the tape more than company news

rows.angle: Shares at ~$5.8-6.0 (Oct 7-8), down ~5% on Oct 7 with the drone group; H1 revenue was only $35.7M against a $150M full-year target, so a very steep H2 ramp is needed with the U.S. Army roughly half of H1 sales, and Teal Drones missed the Gauntlet II top five while private Neros took a ~$100M, 14,000-drone order
rows.watch for: Revenue conversion from the Blue Ops/Havoc maritime and Apium swarm stories, further insider sales, and the next Gauntlet round

rows.angle: Shares at ~$6.7-6.9 (Oct 8), ~29% down YTD even though Ondas reported more than $165M of new orders (Oct 7), $270M+ booked since Jun 30 and a $56M precision-strike order (Oct 5), plus an electronic safe-and-arm award tied to a European loitering-munition program
rows.watch for: Orders only count once shipped and several are acquired or stock-funded (three September acquisitions), so dilution and the H2 revenue ramp are the test; the Q2 EPS miss (-$0.19 vs. -$0.13) and insider-sale filings remain live

private_watchlist.name: Anduril
private_watchlist.note: Talks first reported Jul 24 (following a $5B round at $61B led by Thrive and a16z about two months earlier) remain unclosed with no new reporting found this week; one proposed structure would commit investors to a later, higher-valued round tied to financial benchmarks. 2025 revenue was $2.2B, and the Sep 26 CCA production award (up to ~$5B split with General Atomics) is real production revenue regardless of when the round closes.

private_watchlist.name: Shield AI
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the ~$2B round at $12.7B. Competes for the Navy's up-to-$800M ISR task-order pool with V-BAT alongside NATO eastern-flank orders.

private_watchlist.name: Saronic
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.75B Series D plus an early-September add-on. Building out its Port of Gulfport site toward 20+ autonomous surface vessels a year by 2027.

private_watchlist.name: Helsing
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.8B round closed Jul 13, the largest defence-tech round in European history. Continues fielding the HX-2 strike drone in Ukraine.

bear_case.title: The stopgap budget freezes the programs the growth stories depend on
bear_case.description: The continuing resolution runs to Dec 11 and blocks new starts for 150+ programs; Golden Dome has under $400M of base-budget authority against a $17.5B request (~$17.1B needs reconciliation), the $54.6B DAWG drone line cannot begin, and Pentagon leadership has flagged a $500B-$700B gap between plans and likely appropriations.
bear_case.counter: Congress has historically backfilled priority programs after a CR, and the reconciliation route could still deliver Golden Dome funding.

bear_case.title: Public-market valuations remain stretched
bear_case.description: Even after this week's ~5% pullback in drone names, Palantir (~$206-209 after the Oct 9 rally) trades at a premium multiple (~85x forward earnings last confirmed) and the S&P Aerospace & Defense sub-index sits near 32x forward earnings versus roughly 20x for the S&P 500 — a premium the sector has to keep earning.
bear_case.counter: Palantir's 92.8% revenue growth and rising EPS estimates are far faster than higher-multiple software peers.

bear_case.title: Private-market valuations are drawing bubble comparisons of their own
bear_case.description: Early-stage rounds price at 17x-50x revenue, Anduril's ~$100B target remains unclosed ten weeks on, and the Bank for International Settlements has compared the sector's pricing to the AI-infrastructure buildout it already calls bubble-like.

bear_case.title: The Pentagon's drone competitions keep favoring private newcomers over listed pure-plays
bear_case.description: Gauntlet II leaders Neros and Perennial Autonomy won real orders (Neros: ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones on Oct 1), while Red Cat's Teal Drones, Ondas's Ascent Aerosystems and Kratos all missed the top five.

bear_case.title: Contract wins and beats aren't rescuing the pure-play stocks
bear_case.description: AeroVironment beat Q2 estimates ($0.59 vs. $0.22 EPS) and won a $464.8M laser award yet trades near $137, ~42% down YTD; Ondas reported $165M of new orders on Oct 7 and still fell ~5% that day and again on Oct 8, and Kratos slid to ~$42.
bear_case.counter: The ~$232 consensus target implies substantial upside if backlog converts to earnings.

bear_case.title: Rheinmetall's backlog no longer moves the stock — execution does
bear_case.description: A €80.5B backlog hasn't stopped a ~40% YTD slide to €935.30; Berenberg's Oct 10 downgrade to Hold (target cut to €1,020), delivery delays, quality concerns, negative operating free cash flow and the F126 loss are the focus ahead of Nov 5 Q3 results.
bear_case.counter: CEO and board-linked insider purchases this week suggest management sees the de-rating as overdone.

bear_case.title: UK fiscal strain is now a risk for UK defence names
bear_case.description: BAE Systems fell >5% in a week to ~1,832p on Oct 7 as higher gilt yields and talk of delaying the UK's 3%-of-GDP defence target (possibly to Q3 2027) raised doubts about domestic funding, despite a record £84.0B backlog.
bear_case.counter: Roughly half of BAE's revenue is U.S.-linked and the order book is multi-year, so near-term revenue is less exposed than the share price implies.

catalysts.title: Berenberg downgrades Rheinmetall to Hold, cuts target to €1,020

catalysts.title: Drone stocks sell off despite order news
catalysts.description: Ondas fell ~5% two days running despite $165M of new orders; AeroVironment (~$137) and Red Cat (~$6) fell ~5% on Oct 7 and the JEDI drone ETF dropped ~4%.

catalysts.title: BAE Systems slides >5% on UK defence-spending delay fears
catalysts.description: Shares ~1,832p as gilt yields rose and the UK may push its 3%-of-GDP target out to Q3 2027 or later.

catalysts.title: Pentagon awards Neros ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones after Gauntlet II; CR to Dec 11 delays 150+ programs
catalysts.description: A private company took the first big Drone Dominance production order; the continuing resolution freezes new starts including Golden Dome and the $54.6B DAWG line.

catalysts.title: Upcoming: Rheinmetall Q3 2026 results
catalysts.description: Investors will scrutinize backlog composition and cash conversion; L3Harris has also set its Q3 earnings date.

etfs.name: Invesco Aerospace & Defense

positions.name: BAE Systems

Directly accessible on UK platforms with no wrapper needed.

positions.name: Kratos Defense
positions.note: The Sep 26 CCA production award keeps GE GEK800 engine optionality alive, but shares fell ~17% in a week to ~$42 with the drone group (JEDI ETF -4% on Oct 7), Kratos again missed the Gauntlet II board, and the Dec 11 CR delays new starts — small size only. Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: AeroVironment
positions.note: A Sep 9 beat ($0.59 vs. $0.22 EPS) and the $464.8M laser award (plus a first international order) haven't stopped a slide to ~$137 (~42% down YTD, below both moving averages, -5% on Oct 7) — small size only until execution shows up. positions.name: L3Harris
positions.note: At $236.92 (Oct 8) the stock sits on its $233 52-week low with a Hold consensus; the ~$6B THAAD propulsion contract is real, but the CR freezes new THAAD production starts and Golden Dome funding and the Kubasik exit is unexplained — a price worth watching, not a confirmed thesis. Also sits in the Space sleeve via satellite work — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Rheinmetall

positions.name: Palantir
positions.note: Goldman's upgrade to Buy ($230) and Barclays' Overweight ($265) pushed the stock to a record ~$206-209 on Oct 9, but with growth (Q2 revenue +92.8%) already priced at ~85x forward earnings, the rally shrinks the margin of safety rather than widening it. Also anchors the AI sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Ondas Holdings

Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Red Cat Holdings
